title: Slow Cooker Buffalo Chicken Pasta
description: A high-protein, keto-friendly buffalo chicken pasta dish cooked in a slow cooker.
steps: Cook your chicken, Buffalo sauce, ranch & ranch seasoning for 3-4 hours on high.
Top with your pre-boiled pasta and shredded cheese.
Once the cheese gets melty, serve it and enjoy!
notes:
Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1BcqiowzD1/

Nutrition: Serving 1 bowl · Calories Approximately 400 kcal · Fat 25g · Saturated fat 10g · Unsaturated fat 15g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 80mg · Sodium 900mg · Carbs 10g · Fiber 2g · Sugar 3g · Protein 20g

healthy: Low carb pasta adds fiber and cuts refined carbs.
not_healthy: Buffalo sauce, ranch dressing and ranch packet make it very high in sodium.
Ranch dressing and cheese add fat.
